name: Exif Manipulate
description: Clean EXIF data from uploaded images.
project_description: Exif Manipulate strips EXIF metadata from images on upload, using the pure-PHP fileeye/pel library. Modern cameras and phones embed privacy-sensitive data (notably GPS coordinates, camera model and timestamps) in image files; this module removes that data automatically for every uploaded JPEG and TIFF via a hook_file_insert() implementation, while deliberately preserving the EXIF orientation tag so images still display the right way up (leaving the companion exif_orientation module unaffected). An optional confirm form at /admin/config/media/exif_manipulate queues already-stored files in a public-files location for the same cleaning via cron. The module is built with extension points in mind so it can grow beyond stripping data toward inserting new data. It requires the fileeye/pel PHP library (installed automatically with Composer) and has no other Drupal module dependencies.
